description: A mod that provides a LLM interface inside of Minecraft.

mods.name: MCLLM
mods.description: MCLLM is a fork of MCChatGPT for players who want to use non-OpenAI LLM servers. You are not locked into OpenAI's service and can use alternatives like DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, among others.
